script.narration: Never enter an intersection like this.

script.narration: When turning left at a green light, always keep your front wheels pointed straight while waiting. If you turn them early and get rear-ended, you get pushed straight into oncoming traffic.

script.narration: Like if this helped, follow for daily driving tips. Did you knew this rule? Comment yes or no, because never enter an intersection like this.

description: Essential driving tips for beginners to stay safe at busy intersections. Learn proper wheel positioning when waiting to make a left turn to avoid dangerous collisions.
